title: GullyCraft
description: Made by GullytheGatito, 2030's Largest Minecraft Social Network! Java & Bedrock Come Hang Out!
body:
# 2030's Largest Minecraft Social Network
This server is a place for casual or community-seeking gamers and come to hang out! Cat themed to the max and developed by one of the world's most globally celebrated cat enthusiasts, Gullys_Dad

On Gullycraft you can enjoy:
- Survival
- - Basic Land Claims and Economy
- - CatMaps
- - Super easy to use menus for every command
- Creative Plots
- - Dedicated plots for survival planning or build showcasing
- - World edit
- - Custom mob spawn eggs
- r/Place Gamemode
- - Shared community canvas with a pixel contribution cooldown!
- - Leave your mark and reach the top of the pixel placement leaderboard!
